The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] soldier [[Vildar Blin]] had a '''brother''' who betrayed his family by joining the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]. As a result, Vildar left his post with local [[Corulag security force|security forces]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] to join the Rebellion.
